scope: Unconditional static approval of the exact frozen profiling-only copier/collector/interface proposals below. This is not approval or execution of a future completed-review receipt, file plan, retention copy, baseline result or publication.

setup_failure_classification.binding: Existing halted execution SHA link is checked against the captured setup_failure_execution role.

restore_bijection_amendment.binding: Exact seven captured-input descriptors are required and bound to admitted historical bytes or the original mesh hard pin; ordered-cell arithmetic and no physical qualification transfer are checked.

scope_clarification.binding: Actual existing schema and no-permission-expansion/no-frozen-receipt-edit flags are checked.

future_attribution_interface.binding: Actual completed baseline execution/profile path+SHA, source/runtime/native identity and exact public-call/wall/process-CPU measurements are mandatory, not inferred from passed:true alone.

resolved_v1_findings.finding: A self-described empty or incomplete custody.files list could satisfy the v1 loop while the summary claimed actual saved fixture and mesh retention.
resolved_v1_findings.resolution: All twelve exact capsule names are mandatory once each; rows must use exact source/path/SHA/byte fields, safe relative paths and hard-coded source/hash/size pins. Every matching admitted capsule body is checked.

resolved_v1_findings.finding: The v1 attribution role required only passed:true and could be unrelated to the actual captured baseline.
resolved_v1_findings.resolution: An explicit measured attribution schema, exact baseline execution/profile refs, fixed literal baseline identity and matching measured call/wall/CPU values are required. Independent interpretation remains a separate review, not a collector inference.

resolved_v1_findings.finding: The v1 restore role and method documents were separately indexed but some defining execution/input crosslinks were not checked.
resolved_v1_findings.resolution: restore_probe must equal the actual restore execution output path/hash; halt interpretation binds the failed execution; the seven exact amendment input descriptors bind the admitted originals or known mesh pin.

static_assessments.narrow_scope: FreeCAD-882 requires profiling and evidence-supported bounded-reuse opportunity identification only. No unconditional implementation, candidate, speedup, new solve, fresh physical gate, build or installation branch is introduced or implemented. Earlier prospective optimization obligations remain conditional prose, with the existing scope clarification retained rather than old plans rewritten.
static_assessments.future_refusal: The collector requires an exact separately root-approved plan SHA, a completed profiling review with explicit scope, the complete role set and actual baseline/report links. Missing or pending baseline/attribution roles fail before publication; no future PASS is inferred from a label.
static_assessments.historical_truth: The failed setup remains passed:false and is not classified as export timing or product reproduction. Restore observation remains zero-write observation rather than orientation or physics qualification. Historical live-session IDs, original mesh, restored map and new profile baseline remain distinct.
static_assessments.fixture_replay_durability: The twelve-file nonrecursive copier captures hard-pinned source buffers, checks original fences and exact copies, and writes a new custody receipt. The collector requires actual exact original FCStd3128, historical membership8f4f and restored connectivitya107 bytes plus all nine other hard-pinned files; no hash-only model substitution is allowed. The two oracle JSON sizes/hashes were independently checked as13069/10228 bytes and9142f5aa/42fa6289 prefixes.
static_assessments.capture_and_fences: Plan, qualification, role and payload parsing uses the captured byte map. Baseline output descriptors must match all eight admitted outputs; QA source hashes link to actual executed manifests. Originals and approved plan are rehashed after staging and after publication. The collector neither imports helpers nor runs pstats/native/Git/qualification code.
static_assessments.privacy: Only explicit known task/repository/app-FEM source roots and approved regular non-symlink paths are admitted. Raw user/app/dependency inventories, configs, environments, caches, vendor/runtime trees and FRD/DAT are excluded by path, suffix, JSON shape/key and binary-magic guards. The only FCStd exception is the exact retained generic3128 file; own-generated .prof is a bound diagnostic blob and never unmarshaled or executed.
static_assessments.exact_storage_and_provenance: Original bytes, literal paths, statuses and fingerprints remain untouched. Large payloads use deterministic gzip storage with separate original/stored/decoded hashes and sizes. Same basenames across historical QA versions do not imply aliases; explicit paths and hashes remain distinct. Replay needs a new explicit configuration and matching external runtime, not automatic execution of historical absolute paths.
static_assessments.new_only: Check-only performs verification without filesystem writes. Retention requires a new capsule directory; publication requires a new evidence directory and summary, uses exclusive file creation and checks exact output coverage/bytes. No existing app, source, receipt or publication is overwritten.
static_assessments.remaining_product_claim_limits: A successful byte archive is not bead closure, optimization, speedup, native accuracy, installation or engineering acceptance. CPU excludes native children, profiling overhead remains disclosed, cumulative times overlap, and historical unprofiled duration is not a matched speedup denominator. Oomakhi and existing1percent/5percent numerical/engineering holds remain untouched.

root_follow_through_not_preclaimed: Wait for actual baseline completion and independently review actual attribution/opportunity findings.

Prepare and review the exact completed review, attribution interface and approved path/hash/size/kind/classification plan; include exact copier, authoritative collector, proposal/amendment and final review source bytes as promised by the publication contract.
Root alone runs check-only before separately approved retention/publication execution, then obtains the stated independent exact index/decoded-byte/privacy/summary audit.
